dialogue.content: こんにちは13時から始めさせていただきます。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello, we'll be starting at 1:00 PM. Thank you for being here today.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。ご相談ありがとうございます。はじめに年齢、性別をお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for reaching out. First, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 14歳　女
dialogue.English: 14, female.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。本日は、どのようなご相談でしょうか？どうぞ、お話ししやすいところからお話しください。
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today? Please feel free to start wherever you feel most comfortable.

dialogue.content: 学校へ行くと気持ち悪くなる
dialogue.English: I feel nauseous when I go to school.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、あなたの状況をよく理解したいので、いくつか質問してもいいですか？
dialogue.English: I see. To better understand your situation, would it be okay if I ask you a few questions?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それは、いつ頃からなのかな？
dialogue.English: About when did this start?

dialogue.content: いつかな・・気づいたら・・
dialogue.English: I'm not sure... It just started happening before I knew it.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、どんな感じで　気持ちが悪くなるのかな？
dialogue.English: I see. What does it feel like when you feel nauseous?

dialogue.content: 吐きそうな感じ
dialogue.English: Like I'm going to throw up.

dialogue.content: うんうん、それはとても不快に感じてしまうね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, that must feel very uncomfortable.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 朝、おうちを出るときは大丈夫かな？
dialogue.English: Are you okay when you leave home in the morning?

dialogue.content: はい。でもどうせ学校へ行くとそうなるから、しんどい
dialogue.English: Yes. But knowing it's going to happen when I get to school anyway is exhausting.

dialogue.content: そうなんだねまた、気持ちが悪くなると思うと、おうちを出るのもしんどくなってしまうね。
dialogue.English: I see. Thinking that you'll feel nauseous again must make it difficult to even leave home.

dialogue.content: はい。だから休みがちになっちゃって
dialogue.English: Yes. That's why I end up missing school a lot.

dialogue.content: 学校に行けないときもあるんだね。休んでしまったと思ってしまうのかな？
dialogue.English: So there are times you can't go to school. Do you feel bad about missing it?

dialogue.content: 行けなかったな。て思います。
dialogue.English: I think to myself, 'I couldn't go.'

dialogue.content: うんうん、行きたいのに行けないのは悲しいですね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm. It must be sad when you want to go but can't.

dialogue.content: 行きたいとも行きたく無いとも思わないけど。
dialogue.English: I don't really feel like I want to go or don't want to go, though.

dialogue.content: そう思うのですね。教えてくれて、ありがとう。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how you feel. Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: いえ
dialogue.English: You're welcome.

dialogue.content: 気分が悪くなるとき、何か嫌だなと感じる事はあるかな？
dialogue.English: When you start to feel nauseous, is there anything happening that you find unpleasant?

dialogue.content: わからない。特にない
dialogue.English: I don't know. Nothing in particular.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、周りのお友達は、心配してるかな？
dialogue.English: I see. Are your friends worried about you?

dialogue.content: 友達はあまりいない。
dialogue.English: I don't have many friends.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、いつも、一人なのかな？
dialogue.English: I see. Are you usually alone?

dialogue.content: ひとり
dialogue.English: Alone.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、誰にも相談出来なくて今日は来てくれたんだね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you came here today because you didn't have anyone you could talk to about this.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今日は、話しに来てくれてありがとう。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming to talk with me today.

dialogue.content: いえ
dialogue.English: You're welcome.

dialogue.content: お母さんには相談してるかな？
dialogue.English: Have you talked to your mom about this?

dialogue.content: お母さんは忙しいから
dialogue.English: My mom is busy.

dialogue.content: あまり、聞いてもらえてない感じなんだね。
dialogue.English: So it feels like she doesn't really have time to listen.

dialogue.content: 心配かけたくないし
dialogue.English: And I don't want to worry her.

dialogue.content: お母さんを思っているんだね。優しいですね。
dialogue.English: You're thinking of your mom. That's very kind of you.

dialogue.content: お母さん頑張ってるから
dialogue.English: Because my mom is working so hard.

dialogue.content: お仕事頑る、自慢のお母さんなんだね。学校の先生にも話せていないのかな？
dialogue.English: She works hard; you must be proud of her. Have you been able to talk to your teachers at school about this?

dialogue.content: 学校の先生は嫌いなので話したいと思いません
dialogue.English: I don't like my teachers at school, so I don't want to talk to them.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、嫌いなのは何故なのか、聞いてもいいかな？
dialogue.English: I see. May I ask what makes you dislike them?

dialogue.content: 生徒に興味なさそう
dialogue.English: They don't seem interested in their students.

dialogue.content: 声も掛けてくれない感じかな？
dialogue.English: Does it feel like they don't even talk to you?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 先生からの、この言葉、いやだったな　とかあるかな？
dialogue.English: Is there anything specific a teacher has said that bothered you?

dialogue.content: ないです。そんな話したこともないけど
dialogue.English: No. It's not like I've ever really talked with them that much, though.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、あまり関わりたくないと思っているんだね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you feel like you don't want to interact with them much.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それは、何かストレスになるような事はあったかな？
dialogue.English: Has anything happened that might be causing you stress?

dialogue.content: 特にないです
dialogue.English: Nothing in particular.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、学校に居ても誰も信用出来ないみたいな感じかな？
dialogue.English: I see. Does it feel like you can't trust anyone at school?

dialogue.content: いえ、普通です
dialogue.English: No, it's just... normal.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、今、学校で楽しいことは何かあるかな？
dialogue.English: I see. Is there anything fun at school for you right now?

dialogue.content: 別に特にないです。
dialogue.English: Not really, nothing in particular.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、体調が悪くなる時、はどんな時だろう？
dialogue.English: I see. Under what kind of circumstances do you start to feel unwell?

dialogue.content: 学校へ着いたら、気持ち悪くなります。
dialogue.English: I start to feel nauseous when I arrive at school.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、また、今日も悪くなるかもと思うと不安になるね。
dialogue.English: I see. It must be worrying to think, 'Maybe I'll feel sick again today.'

dialogue.content: はい。そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: その時は、先生に言うのかな？
dialogue.English: Do you tell a teacher when that happens?

dialogue.content: 先生には言いません。眠たくなって授業中も寝てます。
dialogue.English: I don't tell my teachers. I just get sleepy and end up sleeping during class.

dialogue.content: 具合が悪いこと言えなくて、我慢しているんだね。早退しないで頑張っているんだね。
dialogue.English: So you can't tell them you're feeling unwell, and you're just enduring it. You're trying hard to get through the day without leaving early.

dialogue.content: そうですね。でもよくないと思ってる。
dialogue.English: That's right. But I know it's not a good thing to do.

dialogue.content: そっか、良くなると思って乗り切ろうと頑張ってしまうんだね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you push yourself to get through it, hoping you'll start to feel better.

dialogue.content: でもどうしていいのかわからない。
dialogue.English: But I don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいか分からなくて今日、相談に来てくれたんだね。どうしていくか一緒に考えていこうね。眠たくなるみたいだけと、おうちでちゃんと睡眠取れてるかな？
dialogue.English: You came to talk today because you don't know what to do. Let's think about it together. You mentioned feeling sleepy, are you getting enough sleep at home?

dialogue.content: まぁなかなか眠れない時もあるけど、基本はちゃんと寝てます
dialogue.English: Well, there are times I have trouble sleeping, but I usually sleep fine.

dialogue.content: うんうん、
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 具合悪い時は眠れなかった時かな？
dialogue.English: Do you feel unwell on days when you couldn't sleep?

dialogue.content: 夜すごく辛くなって泣いてしまったりして
dialogue.English: At night, it gets really tough, and I end up crying.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、夜、急につらくなるんだね。涙が出るんだね。それは、どうして？
dialogue.English: I see—at night it suddenly becomes really hard for you, and you cry. Do you have a sense of why that is?

dialogue.content: どうしてだろう。わからない
dialogue.English: I wonder why. I don't know.

dialogue.content: そっか、それも辛いね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be difficult, too.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そろそろ、時間になるけど　次に相談来てくれるまでに、体調が悪くなったら誰でも良いから伝えて、早退して欲しいな
dialogue.English: We're nearly out of time, but until our next session, if you start to feel unwell, I'd like you to tell someone—anyone—and leave early.

dialogue.content: 無理して、頑張らなくても大丈夫だよ！
dialogue.English: You don't have to push yourself so hard. It's okay!

dialogue.content: 早退していいんですか。わかりました。
dialogue.English: It's okay to leave early? Okay, I understand.

dialogue.content: ただ、お母さんには伝えてほしいな
dialogue.English: I would like you to let your mom know, though.

dialogue.content: お母さんに前に一度ちらっと言ってみたことあります
dialogue.English: I did mention it briefly to my mom once before.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、なんていってたの？
dialogue.English: I see. What did she say?

dialogue.content: 気持ち悪くなるって
dialogue.English: That I feel nauseous.

dialogue.content: うんうん、
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: ぼちぼちがんばりな〜って感じでした
dialogue.English: She was like, 'Just take it easy and do your best.'

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、その時、どう思ったの？
dialogue.English: I see. How did you feel then?

dialogue.content: ほっとしました
dialogue.English: I felt relieved.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、頑張ろうと言う気持ちが強いんだね。また、時間があるとき相談に来てくれたらうれしくおもいます。今日は話してくれてありがとう。
dialogue.English: I see. You have a strong desire to try your best. I would be happy if you came to talk again when you have time. Thank you for talking with me today.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: 失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Goodbye for now.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.
